selection.method: Farthest-profile selection over normalized structural and basic-method residual features, then individual coordinate-based editorial notes. Search nodes do not select the tier.

tierBasis: Provisional editorial grouping by residual constraint scope; search nodes are proof cost only.

sudoku: After naked and hidden singles stop, look for candidates confined to a row or column within a box, and for equal-sized candidate subsets that reserve cells. Apply each elimination to the crossing unit.

Recompute candidate locations after every placement. The retained singles-only profile deliberately stalls; uniqueness is independently proved, but an advanced human solving trace still needs editorial playtesting.
